text: I just moved, and I have so much stuff.
So where did I put my passport?
This is [OtaghDB](/Otˈɑɡdˌibˈi/). [Otagh](/Otˈɑɡ/) means room, in Persian.
Snap a photo, and tap the thing you mean.
Sam cuts it out, and [Qwen](/kwˈɛn/) names it, sorts it, and tags it.
Then say where it lives: the room, the furniture, even the drawer.
Or photograph a whole room at once.
[Qwen](/kwˈɛn/) finds every object, and Sam cuts all eight out in one pass.
Later, just ask where something is. It searches your own database, and only points at things that really exist.
It builds a packing list from what you already own, and tells you what's missing.
You can search by how things look.
And in a store, check whether you already own something, before you buy it twice.
Every item even becomes a pixel sprite, made from its own cutout.
And all of it runs on your laptop, with open-weight models. No API keys. No cloud.
